status: preregistered specification; runner must be committed and independently reviewed before teacher generation
hypothesis: A fixed query-only Hessian candidate search with public-residual tangent refinement and multiscale coupling approximation generalizes to fresh owned bias-free SwiGLU teachers under isolated continuous-query access.
scope: Full isolated block approximation and identifiable gate/rank-one coupling diagnostics, not whole Transformer, final-text API extraction, original U/D factor values or universal reconstruction.
teacher_distribution: Independent Gaussian G[64,32],U[64,32],D[32,64], each std=specified scale. Fresh secret seed per teacher from OS entropy; no rejection/resampling based on difficulty.
authorized_access: Chosen continuous block inputs and complete float64 vector forward responses only; no teacher weights, activations, analytic gradients or true directions to learner.

hessian.probe_distribution: Gaussian coordinate std4, fixed public probe seed20261024

direction_solver.acceptance: strict decrease of saved public Hessian residual only

sealed_evaluation.inputs: fresh secret independent normal draws, fixed before learner runs
sealed_evaluation.matching: descending global absolute cosine greedy one-to-one, exactly64 candidates required; never used by fitting
secondary: relative error percentiles with explicit denominator floor
coupling Frobenius error per matched unit
elapsed time and sampled process-tree RSS/limit

boundaries: Teacher truth and heldout inputs stored outside Git and learner argv/env/data
Freeze solution hash before evaluator starts
Exclusive consumed-marker creation before any private or heldout read; no repeat evaluation or tuning
Record failure/budget stop/ill-conditioning, no automatic retry, added starts, rescues or threshold changes
Logical process separation on same OS account, not adversarial isolation
Independent verifier reviews code/commitments and reports applicability limitations before any success claim
unchanged_negative_evidence: O3 sealed SwiGLU v1 remains failed (16/64,55/64,52/64). Its iteration-budget v2 is a separate experiment with different access/data; no comparison as equal-access arms.
runner_readiness_gate: The implementation of private preparation/one-time verification must be committed, source-hashed and independently reviewed before generating any fresh teacher; prototype prepare stages with public seed must not be used as a sealed teacher factory.
